selection: First evaluated source and seed0; first/middle/last scheduled diagnostic targets (indices0/5/10). No score or error selection.
mode: Common observed histories; no autonomous rollout or model call
graph_convention: float64 radius classification, lexicographic pair order, uncapped symmetric no self loops; model histories float32
units: Per-coordinate squared residual in checkpoint-normalized acceleration units; base position residuals are decoder-equivalent after division by saved coordinate standard deviations.
actual_residual_conversion: Saved normalized_vector_se_base divided by2; no prediction recomputation.
spatial_convention: Both rows use the last observed positions of the same six-frame input; target frame indexes are zero-based.
claim_limit: One diagnostic example; neither calibration, isolated epistemic/physical uncertainty, allocation benefit, nor autonomous performance is established by this map.
